news.title_en: Nan Ya shakes off 'ghost story', rises over 6% then quickly narrows gains; Formosa Plastics, Formosa Chemicals slightly up
news.summary_en: Last Thursday （22 day) Nan Ya （1303） reported that high-end material M 9 failed AWS (Amazon) verification, a negative news, stock price showed a decline pattern. news.summary: 輝達先進封裝大變革，宣布正開發全新「中介層上整合光學」（OOI）技術，已有原型樣品，以更大面積的中介層取代現行有機封裝基板，並將光學引擎直接移至運算晶片所在的中介層。這將使得中介層躍AI新關鍵戰略物資，聯電（2303）、力積電（6770）成為當紅炸子雞。
news.title_en: Nvidia's advanced packaging major transformation: interposer becomes key strategic material; UMC, Powerchip become red-hot picks
news.summary_en: Nvidia's advanced packaging major transformation, announces development of new 'Optical Integration on Interposer' (OOI) technology, already has prototype samples, using larger area interposer to replace current organic packaging substrate, and moving optical engine directly to interposer where compute chips reside. This will make interposer a new key strategic material for AI, UMC （2303）, Powerchip （6770） become red-hot picks.

news.title: 聯電攜手愛普科技推進AI與高效能運算系統電源解決方案
news.summary: 聯電（2303）與愛普科技於今日共同宣布展開技術與製造合作，推進AI與高效能運算(HPC)系統的供電解決方案。此次合作結合聯電的深溝槽電容(Deep Trench Capacitor, DTC)製程技術與可擴充的晶圓製造能力，以及愛普科技的矽電容設計與系統層級整合技術，共同因應下一代資料中心在電源效率方面的挑戰。
news.title_en: UMC partners with APEC to advance AI and high-performance computing system power solutions
news.summary_en: UMC （2303） and APEC today jointly announced the launch of technology and manufacturing cooperation, advancing power supply solutions for AI and high-performance computing (HPC) systems. This cooperation combines UMC's Deep Trench Capacitor (DTC) process technology and scalable wafer manufacturing capacity, with APEC's silicon capacitor design and system-level integration technology, to jointly address next-generation data center power efficiency challenges.

news.title: Anthropic 承諾未來十年資本支出 金額高達5,180億美元 台廠將受惠
news.summary: Anthropic 本周向美國證券交易委員會遞交S-1招股說明書，文件顯示，Anthropic預計未來十年在雲服務、計算能力和基礎設施方面至少承諾支出5180億美元，其中約八成不可取消或無論實際使用量如何都需要支付，市場對於AI資本支出的不確定性大幅降低。法人看好，這將有利於鴻海（2317）、廣達（2382）、緯創（3231）、緯穎（6669）等主力供應商長期正向發展。

news.title: 不止6檔老AI股！ 輝達黃仁勳喊「產能瓶頸」欽點3台廠擴產
news.summary: 輝達（NVIDIA）宣布攜手全球供應鏈擴大AI製造產能，在公布的供應鏈背板中，除了包含台達電（2308）、技嘉（2376）、緯創（3231）、和碩（4938）、鴻海（2317）旗下鴻佰科技及廣達（2382）旗下雲達科技等6家台灣廠商外，台廠京元電（2449）、欣興（3037）及矽品均入列。其中，輝達將向京元電提供11億美元產能預約預付款，支援在美國建置測試廠房及設備，目標2027年4月進入大量生產；另透過欣興擴充台灣載板產能，並與矽品合作大幅增加共同封裝光學（CPO）所需的光引擎產能。 《詳全文...》
news.title_en: Not just 6 old AI stocks! NVIDIA's Jensen Huang calls 'capacity bottleneck' and endorses 3 Taiwanese factories to expand production.
news.summary_en: NVIDIA announces collaboration with global supply chain to expand AI manufacturing capacity. In the disclosed supply chain backplane, besides including Delta Electronics （2308）, Gigabyte （2376）, Wistron （3231）, Pegatron （4938）, Foxconn （2317） subsidiary Foxconn Interconnect Technology and Quanta （2382） subsidiary CloudTech, totaling 6 Taiwanese manufacturers, Taiwanese companies Chin Yuan Electric （2449）, Unimicron （3037） and Siliconware are also listed. Among them, NVIDIA will provide USD 1100000000 capacity reservation prepayment to Chin Yuan Electric, supporting the construction of test factories and equipment in the US, targeting 2027 year 4 month to enter mass production; also through Unimicron expanding Taiwan substrate capacity, and cooperating with Siliconware to significantly increase optical engine capacity required for co-packaged optics (CPO). 《Read full article...》

items.title: Meta 營收創新高 上調資本支出下限 台廠 AI 供應鏈有望受惠
items.summary: 美國CSP巨頭Meta公布第3季營收創歷史新高紀錄，第4季指引也超出市場預期，顯示算力需求仍持續成長。Meta同時調高2026年資本支出下限，並宣布將發行無投票權新類別股票，支撐AI軍備競賽資金需求。法人看好，CSP廠持續增加資本支出，鴻海（2317）、廣達（2382）、緯創（3231）、緯穎（6669）等重要ODM供應鏈都將持續受惠。

items.title: 美超微業績超預期 為 AI 算力需求注入強心針
items.summary: 美國AI伺服器大廠美超微20日發布業績預告，營收大幅超出預期，毛利率預期也被同步上修，市場判讀為AI算力需求強勁，帶動業績成長。消息一出，不僅美超微大漲，戴爾、慧與等競爭對手也同步大漲，意味著市場對於整體AI需求的看法漸趨樂觀。高盛日前也上修全球伺服器出貨預估量，並點名鴻海（2317）、緯創（3231）、緯穎（6669）的供應鏈將會是主要贏家。

news.summary: 遠傳（4904）電信近年將5G技術投入智慧醫療及緊急救護，遠傳表示，為緊急傷病患爭取黃金救援時間，遠傳「5G緊急救護一站通」22日起正式上路，新增「即時影像、即時資訊、即時協作」三大應用功能，讓緊急救護技術員（Emergency Medical Technician; EMT）在前線執勤時，可在救護車內將患者生理樣態、即時影像、處置作為等資訊透過5G行動網路傳輸，與急救責任醫院急診室共享資訊，讓醫療團隊可透過遠距視訊協作與指導，一同為患者爭取更多黃金救治時間，提升到院前緊急救護品質。

items.title: 輝達先進封裝大變革 中介層躍關鍵戰略物資 聯電、力積電成當紅炸子雞
items.summary: 輝達先進封裝大變革，宣布正開發全新「中介層上整合光學」（OOI）技術，已有原型樣品，以更大面積的中介層取代現行有機封裝基板，並將光學引擎直接移至運算晶片所在的中介層。這將使得中介層躍AI新關鍵戰略物資，聯電（2303）、力積電（6770）成為當紅炸子雞。

items.title: 力積電真的翻身了？毛利率衝48% 分析師看成熟製程還要漲10%至20%
items.summary: 力積電（6770）第3季營收季增23%，毛利率由28%提升至48%，主要係ASP提升、銅鑼廠停線和產能利用率提升；分析師表示，儘管營業費用（OPEX）因銅鑼廠移機費用增加而增加至14%，但每股獲利（EPS）1.38元，優於市場預期。

items.title: 力積電法說會／明年代工價拚漲一至兩成 新廠評估台灣、新加坡、日本
items.summary: 力積電（6770）總經理朱憲國21日表示，成熟製程產能持續吃緊，2027年代工價格目標再漲10%至20%，正與客戶協商長約、鎖定價量。隨漲價效益逐步反映，預期第4季營收續有雙位數成長，並啟動新廠規劃。

news.summary: PCB族群東南亞布局推進，其中泰國最多廠包含臻鼎-KY（4958）、欣興（3037）、金像電（2368）、華通（2313）、台虹（8039）、聯茂（6213）、台燿（6274）、騰輝電子-KY（6672）都已布局卡位，至於馬來西亞封測供應鏈優勢，台光電（2383）、精成科（6191）也已插旗，金居（8358）近期並已宣布設廠投資。
news.title_en: Research: PCB Group Southeast Asia Layout Thailand Most Factories Malaysia Packaging and Testing Supply Chain Advantage
news.summary_en: PCB group Southeast Asia layout advances, with Thailand having the most factories including Zhen Ding Technology-KY（4958）, Xinxing Electronics（3037）, Kinpo Electronics（2368）, Huatong（2313）, Taihong（8039）, Lianmao（6213）, Taiyao（6274）, Tenghui Electronics-KY（6672） all having positioned themselves; regarding Malaysia's packaging and testing supply chain advantage, Taiguang Optoelectronics（2383）, Jingcheng Technology（6191） have also planted flags, and Jinju（8358） recently announced factory investment.

news.title_en: Not just 6 old AI stocks! NVIDIA's Jensen Huang calls 'capacity bottleneck' and endorses 3 Taiwanese factories to expand production.
news.summary_en: NVIDIA announces collaboration with global supply chain to expand AI manufacturing capacity. In the disclosed supply chain backplane, besides including Delta Electronics （2308）, Gigabyte （2376）, Wistron （3231）, Pegatron （4938）, Foxconn （2317） subsidiary Foxconn Interconnect Technology and Quanta （2382） subsidiary CloudTech, totaling 6 Taiwanese manufacturers, Taiwanese companies Chin Yuan Electric （2449）, Unimicron （3037） and Siliconware are also listed. Among them, NVIDIA will provide USD 1100000000 capacity reservation prepayment to Chin Yuan Electric, supporting the construction of test factories and equipment in the US, targeting 2027 year 4 month to enter mass production; also through Unimicron expanding Taiwan substrate capacity, and cooperating with Siliconware to significantly increase optical engine capacity required for co-packaged optics (CPO). 《Read full article...》

台股分化明顯，金融、電信領漲，半導體、電子零組件回落。外資買超金融、航運，賣超半導體。AI題材支撐載板、伺服器、被動元件長線邏輯，短線技術面多偏弱震盪，關注法人籌碼動向與財報催化。

板塊輪動明顯，金融食品領漲，半導體電子零組件領跌。外資大幅賣超半導體兩千張，買超金融七千張，題材股旋轉快，操作宜精選個股。

金控股領漲受惠公股投信四合一，外資大買超；AI伺服器供應鏈緯創吸金領軍；PCB族群材料漲價題材震盪；電源大廠光寶科動能轉弱；凱基金外資重賣籌碼受損；半導體板塊降溫，資金輪動明顯。

台股呈現板塊輪動，資金由半導體、電子零組件、塑化等高波動族群流出，轉向食品內需、金融、網通AI、航運等防禦與題材股。外資大幅賣超半導體兩千張，買超金融七萬張、航運二.五萬張、食品一.八萬張。技術面上多頭排列個股雖創新高，但RSI普遍過熱，短線面臨回檔壓力；超賣族群如緯穎雖有AI題材支撐，仍須待籌碼企穩。整體觀望為宜，關注季線支撐與法人動向。

台股板塊輪動明顯，金融、網通AI、航運獲外資青睞，半導體、電子零組件遭賣壓。合庫金、彰銀受公股整併與併購題材帶動，法人買超強勁；遠傳5G醫療題材推升股價逼近上軌；群創、世芯、京元、力積電技術面轉弱，外資大幅賣超；瑞昱、聯詠多頭格局完好但動能分歧；萬海航運受惠運價反彈。

Taiwan market mixed with tech weakness offset by financial strength. Semiconductors and components cold, foreign selling persistent. TSMC, MediaTek, Delta under pressure below moving averages with bearish momentum. Hon Hai, ASE show chip accumulation despite declines. Financials Fubon, Cathay maintain uptrends. PCB, memory, plastics face selling. Overall WATCH stance.

Taiwan market shows sector rotation with financials and telecom AI leading while semiconductors and electronic components lag; foreign capital exits chips (-205K shares) but embraces financials (+72K) and shipping (+25K), suggesting defensive positioning amid AI supply chain digestion.

Semiconductors and electronic components lead declines as foreign investors exit, while financials and consumer staples attract inflows. Most tracked names show bearish momentum (RSI<50, MACD negative) despite several maintaining annual uptrends. Key catalysts include memory cycle turnover, AI server demand, and earnings season; watch for foreign flow reversal and MACD signal line crossovers to confirm direction.

Taiwan market shows sector rotation with financials leading on public fund merger tailwinds and record profits, while AI supply chain names attract foreign capital despite semiconductor sector cooling. Technical divergences widen as overbought financials face pullback risk and oversold power supply names await 800V DC catalyst validation.

Market shows sector rotation with financials, telecom, and shipping leading while semiconductors and petrochemicals lag. Foreign capital favors financials and telecom, but sells petrochemicals heavily. Technical divergence widens: financials overbought, AI supply chain oversold, petrochemicals breaking down despite fundamental improvements.

Taiwan market shows sector rotation: financials and telecom lead gains with heavy foreign buying, while semiconductors and electronics lag on massive foreign selling. 5880 and 2801 benefit from merger and M&A themes with strong institutional accumulation. 4904 overbought on 5G healthcare news. 3481, 3661, 2449, 6770 face technical deterioration despite fundamental catalysts. 2379, 3034, 2615 maintain uptrends but momentum diverges.

Mixed market: domestic demand and financials rise on foreign buying; semiconductors and components fall on heavy foreign selling. Steel gains on India demand; auto sales record. PCB names split on SpaceX news; memory and probe cards technically weak despite fundamentals.

Sector rotation favors food, retail, financials; semiconductors and panels weak. Foreign investors buy financials, shipping, retail but sell panels, chips. Mixed technicals: financials overbought, semiconductors oversold.

Market shows sector rotation: food, financials, networking AI, shipping warm with foreign buying; semiconductors, electronic components, plastics cold with heavy foreign selling. Mixed breadth with strong institutional support in select names but cautious momentum. Foreign capital rotating from tech to defensive and AI infrastructure plays.

Market diverges: defensive sectors (food, financials, telecom) rise on foreign buying; tech (semiconductors, components, petrochemicals) falls on heavy foreign selling. Institutional rotation favors domestically oriented names over export cyclicals.

Taiwan market shows rotational divergence: food and financials lead while semiconductors and plastics lag. Foreign capital exits ETFs and tech heavyweights, rotating into financials and cyclical sectors. Breadth weakens with most sectors cooling; watch whether financial momentum sustains or tech selling accelerates.
